name: Ceigall India Ltd
about: Founded in 2002, Ceigall India Limited is an infrastructure construction company with expertise in specialized structural projects, including elevated roads, flyovers, bridges, railway overpasses, tunnels, highways, expressways, and runways.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Ceigall India Ltd is a leading EPC company with over 20 years of experience in infrastructure projects, specializing in highways, expressways, flyovers, tunnels, elevated roads, and metro rail. It follows an asset-light model, operating primarily with leased equipment.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 28.5%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 59.8 to 71.8 days.
